snippet.title: Helsinki Online is finally launching
snippet.description:
Helsinki Online is the entire Helsinki, built from the city's open data, as a multiplayer game you play right in your browser.

Early access starts Thursday 29.10. at 18:00 (Finnish time). Anyone can get the Supporter Edition and play from day one.
On Thursday 5.11. at 18:00 the game opens to everyone: try the city centre for free, or get the Citizen Edition.

Play and sign up: https://helsinkionlinegame.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/TsgS3FxcHS
Coming to Steam later, wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4958560/Helsinki_Online/
